reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I treated the 8 April renewal date as unconfirmed and didn't record it anywhere.

I couldn't check it against anything. There are no Brackenwater Freight Co. files I can see on the share (no contract, CRM notes or profile), and #central-team has no earlier Brackenwater messages. The Central team digests don't mention the account either.

In the reply I said someone should confirm the date with Brackenwater directly or check the signed contract. I offered to update records or set a renewal reminder once it's confirmed. A renewal date isn't a finance figure, so no approval was needed and I didn't ask anyone for one.
